pattern_name: Checkpointed targeted repair instead of full-chain rerun
project_problem_solved: P30 repeatedly used full-chain to find or verify node-local defects, causing cost blowup and noisy root cause.
implementation_implication: expensive runs must prove deterministic/node-level checks passed first
repair should resume from the earliest faulty checkpoint rather than re-run completed nodes
artifact diffs must show what changed

project_problem_solved: FIN agents need many tools and sources, but tool access, context data and workflow templates must be separable and auditable.
implementation_implication: resources are injected context with provenance
prompts are reusable workflow templates or skills
tools are executable and require schema, permission, timeout and artifact refs
rejected_parts: do_not_put credentials or raw source dumps into prompts

project_problem_solved: B端 analyst workbench must support long-running research tasks, reviewer approvals, interrupts, resume, and audit history beyond a single chat turn.
implementation_implication: review/approval is an event in the task ledger, not a chat message
resume must recover pending approvals and current artifacts
long-running task state must survive worker restart
rejected_parts: do_not_replace SQL-final audit with volatile queue state

pattern_name: GenAI observability tied to quality and cost
project_problem_solved: Token usage alone does not explain quality; FIN needs to connect model calls, tool calls, retrieval docs, token/cost, eval scores and final judgment yield.
implementation_implication: trace schema should record node/case/run/model/tool/retrieval/eval attributes
AIE should compare token spend to accepted JudgmentCards and memo claims
raw prompts are not stored by default; digest and artifact refs are stored
rejected_parts: do_not_collect observability without tying it to quality
do_not_store sensitive full prompt by default

project_problem_solved: Skill and memory growth plus context-window pressure caused stale context and overfat agent inputs; context must be selected by authority, task and TTL.
implementation_implication: agents receive role-specific packs rather than raw dumps
memory/context rows need provenance, authority, TTL, supersession and tenant permission
compression artifacts must be replayable and auditable
rejected_parts: do_not_dump all memory into every agent

pattern_name: Enterprise RAG ingestion / parser / index / retrieval control plane
project_problem_solved: FIN has many source lanes, parsers, exact slots and Milvus/BM25/SQL routes; the next contract must make ingestion, parsing, chunking, indexing, refresh and retrieval quality auditable rather than treating RAG as a black-box search tool.
implementation_implication: each retrieved row must trace to raw source/parser/chunk/index/authority
parser failures become typed parser gaps with source and reason
data refresh is a governed pipeline event rather than ad hoc crawler output

pattern_name: Artifact-centered analyst Workbench task and review surface
project_problem_solved: FIN Workbench should not be a chat transcript; users need task queue, progress, evidence drilldown, graph/claim/gap review, deliverable generation, and ops/eval visibility tied to SQL-final artifacts.
implementation_implication: UI actions must write WorkpaperEvent or ReviewAction rows
artifact links must drill from memo to evidence/claim/gap/gate
task progress uses runtime events not frontend-local state

pattern_name: Sandbox, approval and resource scheduler governance
project_problem_solved: FIN agents need crawlers, parsers, model calls, embeddings and document renderers, but each tool and model route must obey permission, network, credential, timeout and GPU/CPU budget boundaries before expensive or unsafe execution.
implementation_implication: tool/network/credential access fails closed when not explicitly allowed
GPU embedding/model slots are queued before CPU spillover
paid/full-chain calls require preflight budget and evidence-mode gates

pattern_name: Single compiled tool contract with authority-sensitive repair semantics
project_problem_solved: A model can satisfy the advertised Tool Schema yet fail hidden local length, cell, facet, metric or role constraints when schema, validator, route and fake are hand-maintained separately.
implementation_implication: schema_validator_fake_and_repair_feedback_share_one_contract_source
cross_family_research_needs_split_into_compatible_atoms
proposal_only_local_format_mismatch_can_return_a_bounded_repair_observation_without_closing_gap_or_promoting_fact
identity_Evidence_NumericFact_Judgment_citation_and_cross_scope_errors_remain_hard_fail
